rationale: With only 26 minutes to close, the stock is sitting at 74% of its intraday range with no clear momentum signal — the last five 1-minute candles show choppy, low-conviction price action oscillating in a tight band around $62.10–$62.70. The negative fundamental backdrop (massive negative free cash flow, heavy debt load, rising rate sensitivity) creates headline risk but the news is over 18 hours old and already partially priced in; there is no fresh catalyst to anchor a directional thesis. The risk/reward of entering a leveraged position this close to forced liquidation at the close, with ATR-based volatility that could easily breach a tight stop, does not justify committing capital.
